# gws CLI: Chat +send helper

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the focused `+send` helper for the gws Chat CLI: one command (`gws chat +send --space ... --text ...`) with required flags documented, an example, and a confirm-before-executing rule since this is a write command. Not a duplicate of `googleworkspace-cli-gws-chat` — it's the narrow usage companion (same publication pattern as the lot 33 `gws-calendar` / `gws-calendar-insert` helpers), covering only message sending with threaded replies and cards deferred to the raw API. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: a write command — always confirm with the user before executing; requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (Chat API generally needs a paid Google Workspace account); install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
